title: Single-turn emergency psychiatric triage across 15 frontier AI chatbots
abstract: arXiv:2604.25415v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: People increasingly turn to general-purpose AI chatbots for advice about emotional and mental health problems, but the ability of these systems to recognize and appropriately triage psychiatric emergencies remains under-characterized.   We evaluated psychiatric triage performance in 15 frontier AI chatbots using 112 clinical vignettes spanning four urgency levels, from routine care to immediate emergency assessment. In each trial (1680 total), a chatbot received a single user message conveying all triage-relevant information from one vignette and recommended a timeframe for care. translated_title: 15个前沿AI聊天机器人的单轮精神科急诊分诊能力评估
translated_abstract: 人们越来越多地向通用AI聊天机器人寻求有关情绪和心理健康问题的建议，但这些系统识别并恰当分诊精神科急诊的能力仍缺乏充分的研究。我们使用112个覆盖四个紧急程度等级（从常规诊疗到需立即急诊评估）的临床病例片段，评估了15个前沿AI聊天机器人的精神科分诊表现。在每次试验（共1680次）中，聊天机器人接收一条包含某病例片段全部分诊相关信息的用户消息，并推荐就医的时间框架。主要结局指标为急诊漏判；次要结局包括分诊准确率和错误的方向。病例片段和用户消息通过经临床医生验证的大语言模型流程生成。在415次急诊试验中，有23次被漏判（5.5%；95% CI 1.8-15.9）。按各紧急程度平均计算的总体准确率范围为42.0%至
tldr: 本研究首次系统评估了15个前沿AI聊天机器人对112个不同紧急程度精神科临床病例的单轮分诊能力，发现急诊漏判率约为5.5%，但各模型总体分诊准确率差异较大（42.0%起），揭示了AI聊天机器人在精神科急诊识别方面的现状与不足。
en_tdlr: This study provides a systematic evaluation of single-turn psychiatric emergency triage across 15 frontier AI chatbots using 112 clinical vignettes, revealing a 5.5% emergency under-triage rate and substantial variation in overall triage accuracy among models.
